# Astryx offline adaptation

Ned contributors replaced the installation/CLI workflow with local read_skill references and an offline starter. Npm Core/CLI 0.7.16 assets have independent npm integrity hashes; the Git commit identifies the reviewed skill and license, not a claim that the npm tarballs were built from that Git commit. Exported primary component documentation is retained as static text; alternate language/dense exports and executable upstream commands are not exposed. CLI guide examples have an offline preface and installation-line omissions. Source and adapted hashes are recorded in the manifest.
